feedback.delivery: Per-stream FIFO; each sample delay is chosen in the input profile range, plus one-tick visibility.
feedback.freshness: Only source resampling creates a new sample_tick. Delivery never refreshes an old timestamp.
feedback.retention: Hold each phase result until that activation is retired; never relabel an old outcome into a new epoch/request.
feedback.receiver_interest_projection: Suppress samples only after the receiver has consumed that stream or retired the activation; omitted samples cannot change control state or the node-transition budget.
feedback.fairness: No assumption that some future delay is small. If maximum latency exceeds max_age, repeated stale delivery remains possible.

faults.budget: At most max_faults explicit injections; interval delivery choices do not consume this budget.
faults.delayed_feedback: Represented by delivery intervals; does not rewrite sampling time.
faults.duplicate_same_request: Duplicate a stored packet without changing identity, epoch or sample_tick.
faults.old_request_feedback: Inject a packet for a different activation; it cannot satisfy the current request.
faults.provider_restart: Increment communication epoch, clear provider latches, invalidate outstanding evidence, abort the run and reconcile; no physical reset or automatic retry.
faults.hold_permission_loss: Set device permit false; no direct material motion or ledger update.
faults.missing_stop_confirmation: Suppress stop evidence for the selected activation; physical stop may still occur.

parallel_failure: Close new submissions, stop all active branches, preserve physical effects, retain unsafe or unknown ownership until explicit isolation/cleanup.

V10b.trigger: first valid observed acceptance; repeated accepted samples do not reset the clock
V10b.window: Use response_window_ticks; finite searches must flag any uncovered tail. A stronger independently proved result may cover beyond the explored horizon.

bounds: All state domains, repeat counts, environment events and search limits must be explicit.
